fieldValues.title: What shape should an exercise have?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (Open exercises), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Keep governance/exercise as it is and write the question and options into its fields, as these exercises do.
- B. Add fields for the question, the options and the evidence, and a lifecycle: open, exploring, ready, decided or set aside.
- C. An exercise is a container: the question as its document, each option a record below it, evidence linked to options.
- D. An option is a type of its own, linked to its exercise, so evidence can support or weaken one option.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: The type has no question, options or lifecycle; 52 exercises exist and none can close; the session and desk treat any exercise not closed or abandoned as open, so all of them stay open forever.
fieldValues.next_action: Write two of these exercises each way and see which one a reader and the session can follow.
